title: Career guidance and investments in education: Experimental evidence from Cambodia
title_zh: 职业指导与教育投资：来自柬埔寨的实验证据
title_primary: 职业指导与教育投资：来自柬埔寨的实验证据
title_secondary: Career guidance and investments in education: Experimental evidence from Cambodia
authors: Esther Gehrke, Friederike Lenel, Claudia Schupp
abstract: Students in low-income contexts often lack guidance in their career decisions, which can lead to a misallocation of educational investments. We report on a randomized field experiment conducted with 1715 students in rural Cambodia and show that a half-day career guidance workshop designed to support adolescents in developing occupational aspirations on average increased educational investments. We document substantial heterogeneity in treatment effects by baseline student performance. While the workshop increased schooling efforts of high-performing students, treated low-performing students reduced their educational investments. We develop a simple model that explains this treatment effect heterogeneity by baseline performance.
abstract_zh: 在低收入背景下的学生往往缺乏职业决策指导，这可能导致教育投资配置不当。我们报告了一项在柬埔寨农村对1715名学生进行的随机实地实验，结果显示，一个旨在支持青少年发展职业抱负的半日职业指导工作坊平均增加了教育投资。我们记录了基于基线学生表现的治疗效果显著异质性。尽管工作坊提高了高表现学生的学业努力，但受治疗的低表现学生减少了教育投资。我们构建了一个简单模型，通过基线表现来解释这种治疗效果的异质性。

title: Information acquisition and liability for unknowable risk
title_zh: 信息获取与不可知风险的责任
title_primary: 信息获取与不可知风险的责任
title_secondary: Information acquisition and liability for unknowable risk
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Some product harm is exogenously unknowable until after some consumers have suffered the harm. There is a legal debate over whether such unknowable harm to these early consumers should be given immunity. This article finds that when the seller bears strict liability with compensatory damage on the unknowable harm, the seller’s incentive is distorted. There is an incentive to secretly over-test the product, so the seller can drop or attempt to fix a harmful product to reduce the public’s detection. At the same time, there is also an incentive to under-test the product to avoid a negative test result being leaked out by a whistle-blower. To achieve the socially optimal outcome under strict liability, the damages on the unknowable harm must be punitive and tailored to the events. Granting immunity for unknowable harm can remove inefficiency without complicated damages. (JEL K13, D83).
abstract_zh: 部分产品危害在消费者遭受损害之前，从外部无法预知。关于此类早期消费者所遭受的不可知损害是否应给予豁免，存在法律争议。本文发现，当卖方对不可知损害承担严格责任并支付补偿性赔偿时，卖方的激励会被扭曲。卖方有动机秘密过度测试产品，以便放弃或尝试修复有害产品，从而减少公众的察觉。同时，也存在动机不足测试产品，以避免负面测试结果被举报者泄露。为实现严格责任下的社会最优结果，对不可知损害的赔偿必须具有惩罚性，并与具体事件相匹配。对不可知损害给予豁免，可以在无需复杂赔偿机制的情况下消除效率低下问题。（JEL K13, D83）

title: Estimating Trends In Mental Distress Using Survey Data
title_zh: 利用调查数据估算心理困扰趋势
title_primary: 利用调查数据估算心理困扰趋势
title_secondary: Estimating Trends In Mental Distress Using Survey Data
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: One way of examining how mental health has changed over time is to use information available in large national surveys. While these survey-based measures are valuable in principle, and have been widely employed in prior research, a number of challenges may limit their practical usefulness or require considerable care in their application. This study uses data on U.S. 18-64 year olds from five major household surveys over the period 1999-2019 to investigate three specific questions. First, do different measures or the same indicator from different data sets consistently show how mental distress has changed over time? Second, how does the performance of single-item measures compare to those of psychometrically validated screeners based on multiple questions? Third, what are the benefits or potential costs of using different functional forms of these measures? The answers to these questions are as follows: 1) the estimated trends vary, often dramatically, across measures and, for the same indicator, across data sets and, as a result, some proxies provide a misleading understanding of how mental health has changed over time; 2) the single-item measures do as well or better than those based on multiple questions; 3) no single functional form demonstrates clear superiority over the others. After demonstrating these points, lessons are elucidated for researchers attempting to use survey data to examine trends in mental health.
abstract_zh: 考察心理健康随时间变化的一种方法是利用大型全国调查中的信息。尽管这些基于调查的指标在理论上具有价值，并已在先前研究中被广泛使用，但若干挑战可能限制其实用性，或要求在使用时格外谨慎。本研究利用1999-2019年间美国18-64岁人群的五项主要家庭调查数据，探讨三个具体问题：第一，不同数据集中的不同指标或同一指标是否一致地反映了心理困扰随时间的变化趋势？第二，单项指标的表现与基于多问题的心理测量学验证筛查工具相比如何？第三，使用这些指标的不同函数形式有何益处或潜在成本？研究结果如下：1）不同指标间，以及同一指标在不同数据集间，估计趋势存在显著差异，甚至差异巨大，导致部分代理指标对心理健康随时间变化的解读具有误导性；2）单项指标的表现不逊于甚至优于基于多问题的指标；3）没有任何单一函数形式表现出明显优于其他形式的优势。在阐明这些发现后，本文为试图利用调查数据研究心理健康趋势的研究者提炼了相关启示。

title: The new EU Pay Transparency Directive may reshape wages and the gender pay gap
title_zh: 新欧盟薪酬透明度指令可能重塑工资与性别薪酬差距
title_primary: 新欧盟薪酬透明度指令可能重塑工资与性别薪酬差距
title_secondary: The new EU Pay Transparency Directive may reshape wages and the gender pay gap
authors: Silvia De Poli, Sofia Maier, Viginta Ivaškaitė-Tamošiūnė
abstract: Equal pay for equal work has been a core EU principle since 1957, yet women across Europe continue to earn less than men, even in very similar jobs. As EU countries begin implementing the new Pay Transparency Directive, greater wage transparency is expected to narrow these gaps. This column explores the potential effects on the 27 EU countries. Equal pay could substantially narrow gender disparities, but the gains are greater where unequal pay among comparable workers is a key driver of the gender pay gap.
abstract_zh: 同工同酬自1957年起便是欧盟的核心原则，然而即便在高度相似的岗位上，欧洲女性收入仍普遍低于男性。随着欧盟各国开始实施新的《薪酬透明指令》，更高的薪酬透明度有望缩小这些差距。本文探讨了该指令对27个欧盟国家的潜在影响。同工同酬可显著缩小性别差异，但在可比劳动者薪酬不平等是性别薪酬差距主要驱动因素的国家，其收益更为显著。

title: Ports, Technology and Inter-City Trade: The Economics and Geopolitics of Evolving Maritime Transport Networks
title_zh: 港口、技术与城市间贸易：演变中的海上运输网络的经济学与地缘政治
title_primary: 港口、技术与城市间贸易：演变中的海上运输网络的经济学与地缘政治
title_secondary: Ports, Technology and Inter-City Trade: The Economics and Geopolitics of Evolving Maritime Transport Networks
authors: Réka Juhász, Dávid Krisztián Nagy, Claudia Steinwender, Woan Foong Wong
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Maritime transport remains the backbone of global trade, yet the port and shipping network that carries it has been transformed by containerization and related technological advances. Drawing on newly available granular data---digitized historical shipping records, georeferenced ship movements, and shipment-level routing information---we present five stylized facts on the structure and evolution of the maritime network. Global shipping activity is highly concentrated among a changing lineup of dominant top ports even as lower-ranked ports disperse, while state-owned Chinese port terminal operators increasingly account for these global volumes, boosting overall port operations while delivering efficiency gains mostly to Chinese vessels. We use these facts to organize a synthesis of a fast-growing literature: containerization reshaped which port cities could expand, reinforced hub-and-spoke concentration that yields large but localized welfare gains, embedded ports in multimodal networks that amplify the returns to infrastructure, and generated market power, congestion, and environmental costs. Together, this evidence shows how evolving maritime technologies simultaneously deepen global integration and heighten the economic and geopolitical importance of critical nodes in the transport network---and of who controls them.
abstract_zh: 海上运输仍是全球贸易的支柱，但承载这一运输体系的港口与航运网络已因集装箱化及相关技术进步而发生深刻变革。基于新获取的颗粒化数据——数字化历史航运记录、地理参照船舶轨迹及单次货运路径信息——我们归纳出关于海运网络结构与演变的五个典型事实。全球航运活动高度集中于排名动态变化的头部港口，而低层级港口则呈现分散化趋势；与此同时，中国国有港口码头运营商在全球吞吐量中的占比持续攀升，在提升整体港口运营效率的同时，其效率增益主要惠及中国籍船舶。我们借助这些事实对快速增长的文献进行系统整合：集装箱化重塑了港口城市的扩张空间，强化了枢纽-辐条式集中格局并带来巨大但局部化的福利收益，将港口嵌入多式联运网络从而放大基础设施回报，同时催生了市场势力、拥堵与环境成本。这些证据共同表明，不断演进的海运技术在深化全球一体化的同时，也加剧了运输网络关键节点及其控制者的经济与地缘政治重要性。

title: A Model of the Data Economy
title_secondary: A Model of the Data Economy
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In a data economy, transactions of goods and services generate data, which is stored, traded and depreciates. How are the economics of this economy different from traditional production economies? How do these differences matter for measurement of GDP, firm values, depreciation rates, welfare and externalities? We incorporate active experimentation and data as an intangible asset to devise a tractable recursive representation of the data economy. The model rationalizes why apps are often “free” and why even non-digital economic activity might be greater than GDP suggests. Calibrating the model using a combination of macroeconomic and financial moments suggests that the mis-measurement in U.S. GDP due to missing value of data has been as high as 6% in 2018.
abstract_zh: 在数据经济中，商品和服务的交易会产生数据，这些数据被存储、交易并发生折旧。这种经济体的经济学特征与传统生产经济体有何不同？这些差异如何影响GDP、企业价值、折旧率、福利和外部性的衡量？我们通过引入主动实验和将数据视为无形资产，构建了一个可处理的数据经济递归表示模型。该模型解释了为何应用程序通常“免费”，以及为何即使非数字经济活动也可能大于GDP所显示的水平。结合宏观经济和金融数据的校准结果表明，2018年因数据价值缺失导致的美国GDP测量误差高达6%。

title: Inflation is not equal for all: The heterogeneous effects of energy shocks
title_zh: 通胀并非人人平等：能源冲击的异质性效应
title_primary: 通胀并非人人平等：能源冲击的异质性效应
title_secondary: Inflation is not equal for all: The heterogeneous effects of energy shocks
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between energy shocks, monetary policy responses, and inflation inequality, defined as the gap between consumer price inflation faced by households at the bottom and at the top of the expenditure distribution, arising from differences in consumption baskets. We use a VAR-based framework to quantify the impact of energy shocks on inflation inequality and to document their contribution to fluctuations in inflation differentials over time. To interpret the empirical evidence, we develop a two-agent general equilibrium model that sheds light on the underlying mechanisms. We show that the impact of energy shocks on inflation inequality intensifies when monetary policy reacts more forcefully to inflation. By estimating the model for the Italian economy, we assess the joint roles of energy shocks and monetary policy in driving the record level of inflation inequality observed in 2022, thereby providing empirical support for the mechanisms highlighted in the theoretical model.

title: The Dynamic Co‐Evolution of International Politics and the Global Trade Network: Evidence From a Stochastic Actor‐Oriented Model
title_zh: 国际政治与全球贸易网络的动态共演化：来自随机行动者导向模型的证据
title_primary: 国际政治与全球贸易网络的动态共演化：来自随机行动者导向模型的证据
title_secondary: The Dynamic Co‐Evolution of International Politics and the Global Trade Network: Evidence From a Stochastic Actor‐Oriented Model
authors: Shanshan Lan, Xiaoying Su, Shiping Yan, Feng Tang
abstract: As globalization faces headwinds from rising geopolitical tensions, the interaction between international politics and trade has become increasingly complex. Moving beyond static gravity models, this paper examines the dynamic co‐evolution of international political relations and the global trade network. Using a Stochastic Actor‐Oriented Model (SAOM) on a dataset of 139 economies from 1996 to 2023, we model the global trade network as an endogenous and evolving system rather than a set of independent dyads. The results show that diplomatic proximity significantly increases the likelihood of trade‐tie formation, and that this effect strengthens markedly after 2016, approaching the explanatory importance of geographic distance. The estimates also reveal strong reciprocity and triadic closure in the trade network, indicating that trade ties emerge within clustered and path‐dependent structures. Overall, the findings suggest that the contemporary trade system is increasingly shaped by the interaction between geopolitical affinity and network embeddedness.
abstract_zh: 随着地缘政治紧张局势加剧，全球化面临阻力，国际政治与贸易之间的互动日益复杂。本文超越静态引力模型，考察国际政治关系与全球贸易网络的动态共同演化。基于1996年至2023年139个经济体的数据集，采用随机行动者导向模型（SAOM），我们将全球贸易网络建模为一个内生且不断演化的系统，而非一组独立的双边关系。结果表明，外交亲近度显著提升了贸易联系形成的可能性，且这一效应在2016年后明显增强，其解释力接近地理距离。估计结果还揭示了贸易网络中强烈的互惠性和三角闭合性，表明贸易联系出现在具有聚类和路径依赖特征的结构中。总体而言，研究结果表明，当代贸易体系日益受到地缘政治亲和性与网络嵌入性之间互动的影响。

title: Trust and Democracy: Political Stability in Times of Economic Crisis
title_zh: 信任与民主：经济危机时期的政治稳定
title_primary: 信任与民主：经济危机时期的政治稳定
title_secondary: Trust and Democracy: Political Stability in Times of Economic Crisis
authors: Nathan Nunn, Nancy Qian, Jaya Wen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the relationship between interpersonal trust and political stability in democratic countries. Using an annual country-level panel dataset covering six decades, we find that recessions are more likely to cause political turnover in countries with lower levels of generalised interpersonal trust. The effect is present in democracies and not autocracies, for turnovers occurring through regular procedures and not coups, and during regularly scheduled election years. We find an analogous connection between trust and leader turnover during recessions when looking across sub-national regions in Europe, across counties in the United States, and across individuals in U.S. counties. Our results highlight the crucial role of generalised trust in ensuring political stability during times of economic turmoil.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究民主国家中人际信任与政治稳定性之间的关系。利用覆盖六十年的年度国家层面面板数据集，我们发现，在普遍人际信任水平较低的国家，经济衰退更易引发政治更迭。这一效应存在于民主国家而非专制国家，体现在通过常规程序而非政变实现的更迭中，且集中于定期选举年份。通过考察欧洲次国家区域、美国各县以及美国各县个体层面的数据，我们同样发现经济衰退期间信任与领导人更迭之间存在类似关联。研究结果凸显了普遍信任在经济动荡时期确保政治稳定性的关键作用。

title: Improving tax revenues in the emerging markets: A Laffer curve analysis
title_zh: 新兴市场税收收入的提升：拉弗曲线分析
title_primary: 新兴市场税收收入的提升：拉弗曲线分析
title_secondary: Improving tax revenues in the emerging markets: A Laffer curve analysis
abstract: Emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs) can significantly improve their tax‐to‐GDP ratios by expanding the tax base and strengthening institutional quality. This paper develops a neoclassical growth model with heterogeneous agents‐ Ricardian and non‐Ricardian households‐to examine fiscal capacity using a Laffer curve framework. It highlights two key constraints in EMDEs: a large untaxed population‐including exempt and informally employed individuals, and institutional weakness reflected in tax evasion, poor audits, and weak compliance norms. Non‐Ricardians are untaxed; Ricardians may evade or pay taxes. Results show that raising tax rates alone is ineffective; broader compliance, limited exemptions, and institutional reforms are essential.
abstract_zh: 新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDEs）可以通过扩大税基和加强制度质量显著提高其税收与GDP的比率。本文构建了一个包含异质性主体——李嘉图家庭与非李嘉图家庭的新古典增长模型，并运用拉弗曲线框架分析财政能力。研究重点揭示了EMDEs面临的两大制约因素：一是大量未纳税人口——包括免税群体和非正规就业者；二是制度薄弱问题，表现为逃税、审计不力及合规意识薄弱。非李嘉图家庭无需纳税，而李嘉图家庭可能选择逃税或正常纳税。研究结果表明，单纯提高税率效果有限，扩大税收遵从度、限制税收豁免及推进制度改革至关重要。

title: Heterogenous impacts of property rights on the climate-smart investments of farming households: Empirical evidence from Nigeria
title_zh: 产权对农户气候智慧型投资的异质性影响：来自尼日利亚的经验证据
title_primary: 产权对农户气候智慧型投资的异质性影响：来自尼日利亚的经验证据
title_secondary: Heterogenous impacts of property rights on the climate-smart investments of farming households: Empirical evidence from Nigeria
authors: Osayi Precious Emokpae, Edeoba William Edobor, Micheal Attah, Nneji Ifeyinwa Umeokeke, Grace Sewuese Orshio 等
official: 官方在线 October 20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Climate-induced extremities deplete agricultural yield and reshape investment incentives. Mitigating the adverse effects of climate change on food systems requires increasing commitments to climate-smart investments (CSIs). Property Rights (PRs) create incentives to utilize resources optimally. However, unless such rights are enforceable, CSIs may remain low. In this study, we specifically interrogated the role of institutions in strengthening or undermining the resilience of food systems by assessing how different land-use rights (formal, semi-formal and informal) impact farming households’ incentives to embrace climate-smart adaptation measures. Data for this study were obtained from the fifth wave of the General Household Survey (GHS) Panel for Nigeria. Data from 1199 farming households were analyzed using the Endogenous Switching Regression (ESR) model. Our results show that holding formal PRs have higher positive correlates with investments in climate-smart adaptation measures than in the counterfactual scenario, and, farming households without such rights exhibit higher positive correlates with investments in climate-smart adaptation measures than in the counterfactual scenario. By contrast, residence in communities that allocate non-formal (semi-formal and informal) PRs significantly improves the CSIs of farming households than in the counterfactual scenario. However, the positive impact on CSIs is significantly lower for farming households in communities that do not allot non-formal PRs than in the counterfactual scenario. Therefore, extending the frontier of non-formal PRs such that communities that hitherto do not wield such rights become empowered to allot them is a core pathway through which institutions in Nigeria can foster extensive commitments to climate-smart adaptation measures among farming households.

title: Manipulation of information in times of crisis: evidence from Covid excess mortality
title_zh: 危机时期的信息操纵：来自新冠超额死亡率的证据
title_primary: 危机时期的信息操纵：来自新冠超额死亡率的证据
title_secondary: Manipulation of information in times of crisis: evidence from Covid excess mortality
abstract: Governmental information manipulation has been hard to measure and study systematically. This paper provides comparable country-level estimates of the extent of misinformation in official data, in a large and diverse set of countries. We hand-collect data from a variety of sources in 134 countries to estimate misreporting of Covid mortality in 2020-2021. We find that information manipulation by governments during this period was remarkably widespread: between 45%–55% of governments misreport the number of deaths. Misreporting is large in magnitude: together, the countries we study reported 5.08 million Covid deaths during 2020-2021, whereas actual Covid mortality was more than double, at 12.47 million. The lion’s share of misreporting cannot be attributed to a country’s capacity to accurately diagnose and report deaths. Contrary to some theoretical expectations, information manipulation takes the form of downplaying rather than exaggerating the severity of the crisis. What characterizes governments that manipulate information? We examine the role of macroeconomic incentives, culture, audience sophistication, and institutions. The evidence strongly suggests that misreporting is higher where governments face fewer social and institutional constraints; in countries holding elections during this period; and in countries with a communist legacy. abstract_zh: 政府信息操纵一直难以被系统性地衡量和研究。本文在大量且多样化的国家中，提供了关于官方数据中错误信息程度的可比国家层面估计。我们手工收集了134个国家多种来源的数据，以估算2020-2021年新冠死亡人数的误报情况。研究发现，在此期间政府的信息操纵行为异常普遍：45%至55%的政府误报了死亡人数。误报规模巨大：我们研究的国家在2020-2021年期间报告了508万新冠死亡病例，而实际新冠死亡率超过这一数字的两倍，达到1247万。绝大多数误报不能归因于国家准确诊断和报告死亡的能力。与某些理论预期相反，信息操纵表现为淡化而非夸大危机的严重性。那么，操纵信息的政府有何特征？我们考察了宏观经济激励、文化、受众成熟度以及制度的作用。证据强烈表明，在面临较少社会与制度约束的政府中、在选举期间的国家中、以及具有共产主义遗产的国家中，误报率更高。类似内容被其他人浏览。

title: Did pandemic relief fraud inflate house prices?
title_zh: 疫情救济欺诈是否推高了房价？
title_primary: 疫情救济欺诈是否推高了房价？
title_secondary: Did pandemic relief fraud inflate house prices?
authors: John M. Griffin, Samuel Kruger, Prateek Mahajan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Pandemic fraud is geographically concentrated and stimulated local purchases, with effects on prices. Recipients of fraudulent Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) funds significantly increased their home purchasing rate compared to recipients of non-fraudulent PPP funds, and house prices in high-fraud ZIP codes increased 5.8 percentage points more than in low-fraud ZIP codes within the same county. In a horse race, pandemic fraud is one of the largest and most robust factors explaining house price appreciation during COVID. ZIP codes with fraud also experienced heightened vehicle purchases and other consumer spending in 2020-21, with a return to normal in 2022.
abstract_zh: 疫情欺诈在地理上呈现集中分布，并刺激了当地购买行为，进而对价格产生影响。与获得非欺诈性薪资保护计划（PPP）资金的受助者相比，欺诈性PPP资金的受助者购房率显著提高，且在同一县内，欺诈高发邮政编码区的房价涨幅比低发区高出5.8个百分点。在竞争性检验中，疫情欺诈是解释新冠期间房价上涨的最大且最稳健的因素之一。欺诈高发邮政编码区在2020-21年间还经历了车辆购买及其他消费支出的增加，而到2022年则回归常态。

title: Potential Growth: A Global Database
title_zh: 潜在增长：一个全球数据库
title_primary: 潜在增长：一个全球数据库
authors: Sinem Kilic Celik, M. Ayhan Kose, Franziska Ohnsorge, Franz Ruch, Salvatore Capasso 等
official: 官方在线 2023-04-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Potential growth—the rate of expansion an economy can sustain at full capacity and employment—is a critical driver of development progress. It is also a major input in the formulation of fiscal and monetary policies over the business cycle. This paper introduces the most comprehensive database to date, covering the nine most commonly used measures of potential growth for up to 173 countries over 1981-2021. Based on this database, the paper presents three findings. First, all measures of global potential growth show a steady and widespread decline over the past decade, with all the fundamental drivers of growth losing momentum over time. In 2011-21, potential growth was below its 2000-10 average in nearly all advanced economies and roughly 60 percent of emerging market and developing economies. Second, adverse events, such as the global financial crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic, contributed to the decline. At the country-level also, national recessions lowered potential growth even five years after their onset. Third, the persistent impact of recessions on potential growth operated through weaker growth of investment, employment, and productivity.
abstract_zh: 潜在增长——经济体在满负荷产能和充分就业状态下能够维持的扩张速度——是发展进程的关键驱动力，也是商业周期中财政与货币政策制定的重要依据。本文构建了迄今最全面的数据库，涵盖1981-2021年间最多173个国家的九种常用潜在增长测算指标。基于该数据库，本文提出三项发现：第一，过去十年间全球潜在增长的所有测算指标均呈现持续且广泛的下降趋势，所有增长基础驱动因素随时间推移逐渐丧失动力。2011-2021年间，几乎所有发达经济体和约60%的新兴市场与发展中经济体的潜在增长率均低于其2000-2010年的均值。第二，全球金融危机和新冠疫情等不利事件加剧了这种下降。在国家层面，经济衰退甚至在爆发五年后仍持续压低潜在增长。第三，衰退对潜在增长的持续性影响通过投资、就业和生产率增长的弱化路径传导。
